stage1.impression: A tight macro of a black woofer in a blue ring, seen through tinted acrylic. It is clean and legible, but the cone and the ring read as smooth, matte CG plastic: no specular sweep, no surface detail, so nothing says 'precision object'. Soft-focused internal frames crowd the edges, and a saturated violet edge stripe on the right and a hot white sliver on the left pull the eye off the driver.

blocking_9: The ring and the cone carry a controlled specular gradient (a soft strip reflection) that describes their curvature; ring lum_range at least 20 across [130,700,200,900] (now 3.1)
The cone shows tonal modelling from the light: lum_range at least 45 over [450,450,1000,1100] (now 26.7) and a visible highlight on the dust cap
The frame is composed around the driver, with the saturated acrylic edge stripe and the clipped left sliver out of the frame or subdued
The internal frames and posts around the driver read as deliberate structure, not soft clutter at the frame edges
The cone and surround show real material micro-detail (paper or poly grain, rubber sheen), not uniform grey

defects.what: Blue ring is dead flat: lum 128-131, range 3.1. No reflection or gradient, so it reads as a 2D disc of plastic
Cone is uniform mid-dark grey (median 48, p5-p95 42-69) with no sheen or texture; the dust cap barely separates (range 13.8)
Saturated violet-blue acrylic edge stripe (RGB median 9/23/88) cuts the frame top to bottom and competes with the ring's blue
Hot near-white sliver at the left edge, 1.03% clipped (median 228)
Top band is busy: dark internals, a cable and frame edges (median 47, range 137)
Bright, busy bottom band of refracted internals (median 166, p95 216); it pulls the eye down
Blotchy, denoiser-smeared gradient on the frosted side panel
Dark cavity and soft-focus box behind the ring's right side read as unresolved clutter

changes.problem: The ring has no specular gradient, so it reads as flat plastic, not a turned, finished part.

change.to: azimuth 0 to +10 (aimed so its mirror reflection lands across the ring's upper-left quadrant), elevation 35, size [0.8, 1.6], strength 6.0, ramp kept

changes.expected: A soft graduated highlight sweeps along the upper-left of the ring and fades toward the bottom, so the ring reads as a finished turned part.

changes.problem: The cone and dust cap get no modelling light, so they read as a flat grey disc.
changes.expected: The cone shades from a lit upper-left to a darker lower-right, and the dust cap gets a soft crescent highlight at its upper-left.

changes.problem: The dust cap has no highlight to mark its dome, so the centre of the image has no focal sparkle.

change.setting: new small area lamp 'cap-kicker', specular only, receivers ['*#0']
change.to: size [0.3, 0.3], orbit azimuth -20, elevation 45, distance 1.5, target the woofer centre (about [0, -0.2, 0.49]), irradiance 3.0, diffuse 0

changes.expected: A small soft specular on the cap's upper-left; the cap reads as a dome.

changes.problem: The framing gives the frame edges to a violet acrylic edge stripe, a clipped sliver and soft internals instead of to the driver.

evidence.measured: edge stripe RGB 9/23/88; the woofer centre sits at about x 640, y 800, left of frame centre

change.to: position x to about 0.30 so the line of sight is near the woofer's axis given rotate_z -20, target shifted to the woofer's centre, lens 200; keep the ring's outer edge about 8% in from the frame's left and right

changes.expected: The ring is centred and fills the square; the edge stripe falls outside the frame or reads as a thin accent at the extreme right.

changes.problem: A bright reflection of the seamless clips at the left edge of the acrylic.

change.to: false (the matte flag at [-1.4, 0.6, 1.2] subtracts the bright left reflection)

changes.expected: The left edge drops to a mid-light tone with no clipping.

changes.problem: The back light makes the bottom band of refracted internals brighter than the hero, which pulls the eye down.

evidence.measured: lum_median 165.7, p95 216.4, versus a ring median of about 129

changes.expected: The bottom band settles below the ring's brightness and the eye stays on the driver.

changes.problem: The denoiser smears the frosted side panel into a blotchy gradient that reads as a render.

evidence.measured: visible mottling in a 1x crop; lum_range 71 over a surface that should be a smooth ramp

changes.expected: The panel's gradient is smooth with no mottling, and fine detail on the cone edges holds.

out_of_scope.request: Give the cone a visible material grain or sheen (coated paper or poly with low roughness) and the surround a satin rubber finish.
out_of_scope.why: This is a material of the speaker's own parts. Light can only partly fake it, and it is the biggest remaining CG tell in this macro.

out_of_scope.request: Reduce the saturation and depth of the acrylic's edge-on violet colour.
out_of_scope.why: That is the speaker's colour, which is fixed; framing (c4) is the only lever here.
